name: Select Enhancer for Elementor Forms with Select2
author: Kamrul Islam

sections.description:
Select2 Support For Elementor Forms adds modern Select2 dropdown features to your Elementor Pro form select fields without writing any JavaScript or custom code.

This plugin automatically converts Elementor Pro form <select> fields into Select2-enhanced dropdowns providing:

  • Beautiful, modern select UI
  • Searchable dropdowns
  • Multi-select support
  • Tagging support (optional)
  • Keyboard navigation
  • Clean design that matches any site

Perfect for large lists, dynamic data, or forms that need better user experience.

✨ Features

  • Automatically loads Select2 on Elementor Pro form fields
  • Works with both single-select and multi-select fields
  • Adds search bar inside the dropdown
  • Fully compatible with Elementor styling
  • Zero configuration — works instantly after activation
  • Lightweight and optimized

🔧 How It Works

Just enable the plugin.
Your Elementor Pro forms will automatically display Select2-enhanced dropdowns.

No shortcode. No settings needed.

🚀 Why Use This Plugin?

Default Elementor select fields don’t support search or rich UI.
This plugin solves that and gives your forms a more modern, user-friendly dropdown.

Perfect for:

  • Country/state lists
  • Category or taxonomy lists
  • Product attribute selections
  • Long dropdown menus
  • Multi-selection forms
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Open any Elementor Pro Form with a select field
  4. The Select2-enhanced dropdown will automatically load

No additional setup required.
sections.faq:
Does it work with Elementor Pro only?

Yes. This plugin enhances the Form widget, which is part of Elementor Pro.

Do I need to add code or shortcode?

No. It works automatically after activation.

Will this slow down my site?

No. The plugin only loads Select2 on pages where Elementor forms exist.

Does it support multi-select fields?

Yes. Multi-select fields become fully supported with Select2.

Does it affect normal Elementor select fields (non-form)?

No. Only Elementor Pro form select fields are enhanced.
